item.text: {"search_note":"I found no direct 2024 evidence of Modi publicly acknowledging responsibility for security-force torture, disappearances, or extrajudicial killings. I also found no clear 2024 evidence of a successful, Modi-led remedial shift that materially reduced these abuses during the year. The best-supported reading is continued failure to protect residents, with only limited institutional checks and self-described reform rhetoric.","evidence":[{"title":"India: Increased Abuses Against Minorities, Critics","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"11 Jan 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/india-increased-abuses-against-minorities-critics","summary":"HRW says BJP-led authorities stigmatized minorities, used politically motivated charges against critics, and that Manipur violence, internet shutdowns, and police failures persisted.
